dedupe_keys.name: instituto canario de estadistica istac airport and aviation datasets

description: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC): airport and aviation datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). Coverage: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about airport and aviation; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Tráfico total de mercancías y correos en los aeropuertos de las islas ; Tráfico total de pasajeros en los aeropuertos de las islas de Canarias; Tráfico total de operaciones en los aeropuertos de las islas de Canari; Operaciones de despegue en los aeropuertos de las islas de Canarias se. Formats seen: JSON, CSV, XML, PC-AXIS, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/istac/aviso_legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
